title: 阿狸·核心素描
description: 狐耳阿狸居中静立，九条白尾分向两侧展开，小蓝色法球与朱红衣袖点出核心特征。

art_direction.medium: hand-drawn graphite and charcoal, confident pencil contours, cross-hatching, sculptural chiaroscuro and visible pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Ahri is an adult fox vastaya woman with long dark hair, amber eyes, upright dark fox ears, three subtle whisker marks on each cheek, and nine distinct white tails. Preserve her poised feminine face and natural heroic comic proportions. Dress her in a fully covering red-and-ivory long-sleeved travel tunic, opaque trousers, fitted boots, and restrained ornamental trim.
art_direction.scene: Full-figure centered portrait of Ahri standing calmly on a small rock, her figure using only the central third of the width. Her EXACTLY NINE white fox tails are the principal graphic structure: arrange FIVE distinct tail tips fanning into open paper on the left and FOUR distinct tail tips on the right, with visible gaps between all nine tips. All tails grow coherently from behind her lower back, not from shoulders. Keep the nine separate complete tips comfortably inside the page; no overlapping tips or cropped tails. Keep her two arms and two legs distinct, one hand holding a quiet small blue orb. A faint far-off Ionian roof is the only background cue. Graphite contours, white paper, charcoal shadows, restrained vermilion clothing accents. No separate fox animal or pet.
art_direction.palette: ivory tails, ink black, deep vermilion, amber and slate blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Single compressed JPEG preview, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
